Players Committee card image of [[I Think I Can Handle Myself (Errata 2)]] (errata PC-E2), game text: “If your female character is defending a battle alone at a site, add one destiny to total power (if Rey, she is also immune to attrition). OR Cancel a weapon destiny targeting your female character. OR Add 1 to your Force drain where you have a female character.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/ithinkicanhandlemyself.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/0f91c9bb73fe33b9c576143ca2fbcfdeffe4b043 0f91c9b] (22 March 2019). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
